questions.subject: Strings
questions.question: Explain the difference between anagram detection and string tokenization in Strings.
questions.ideal_answer: anagram detection and string tokenization differ in several ways: anagram detection is permutation equivalence checking (works by character frequency comparison) whereas string tokenization is splitting into components (works by parsing and lexical analysis). anagram detection is typically used for sorting O(n log n), hash map O(n), while string tokenization is used for split, StringTokenizer, regex. Example demonstrating anagram detection: int[] count = new int[26]; for (char c : s.toCharArray()) count[c-'a']++;. Example demonstrating string tokenization: String[] parts = s.split("\s+");.

questions.question: What is KMP algorithm in Strings and how does it work?
questions.ideal_answer: KMP algorithm in Strings refers to Knuth-Morris-Pratt. It works by O(m+n) pattern matching. Key characteristics include LPS (longest prefix suffix) array construction. Example: lps[i] = length of longest proper prefix which is also suffix. Common pitfalls include pattern preprocessing, no backtracking in text.

questions.subject: Strings
questions.question: Explain the difference between edit distance and longest palindromic substring in Strings.
questions.ideal_answer: edit distance and longest palindromic substring differ in several ways: edit distance is Levenshtein distance (works by minimum operations to transform strings) whereas longest palindromic substring is maximal palindrome finding (works by expand around center or DP). edit distance is typically used for insert, delete, replace operations, while longest palindromic substring is used for center expansion: O(n^2) time, O(1) space. Example demonstrating edit distance: dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][j]+1, dp[i][j-1]+1, dp[i-1][j-1]+cost). Example demonstrating longest palindromic substring: for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { expand(s, i, i); expand(s, i, i+1); }.

questions.question: Explain the difference between string immutability and Unicode and UTF-8 in Strings.
